desc: Dedupe target values and set m = len(unique targets); precompute lcm for each of the 2^m subsets.
For each subset S, scan all nums elements computing cost and retain only the top K = m cheapest elements as candidates.
Collect the union of candidate element indices and run a 0/1 bitmask DP so each element is used at most once; dp[mask] = min ops to cover targets in mask.
Return dp[(1<<m)-1]; verified Example 1 (1), Example 2 (2), Example 3 (0), and nums=[2,16]/target=[3,5] (5).
Sanity-checked edge cases: duplicate targets, m=1, cost-0 elements, and large lcm values.
Worst-case runtime for n=5e4, m=4 is comfortably within limits.
